replay_phase_cpu.phase_boundary_measurement: Tick counters linearly interpolated between 0.5-second samples; excludes any unsampled leading/trailing interval.

entire_lifetime_cpu.phase_boundary_measurement: Tick counters linearly interpolated between 0.5-second samples; excludes any unsampled leading/trailing interval.

performance.cpu_semantics: 100% is one logical CPU; detector process only, excluding ROS replay, FAST-LIO and planner
performance.receipt_latency_semantics: raw-topic receipt at audit subscriber to state receipt at audit subscriber; includes synchronization and ROS transport

additional_box_diagnostics.matching_predicate: Diagnostic only: one-to-one maximum number of box-center pairs within 0.25m, then minimum center distance. No size filter. Detector IDs and marker IDs are not comparable across runs. Frozen acceptance still uses unmodified exact-stamp counts and hit predicates.
additional_box_diagnostics.source_semantics: Current-candidate diagnostics are evidence fields, not manually labeled physical false-positive causes. Unmatched diagnostic sources are explicitly unknown.
additional_box_diagnostics.duration_semantics: Consecutive extra observations of the same detector track ID; frame absence breaks a run. Span is last-minus-first time; sampled duration is observations times median output interval, not physical occupancy duration.

actual_point_event_config.implementation: frame-input point-occlusion prototype; not full M-detector
actual_point_event_config.clustering: connected region growth of actual non-static points
actual_point_event_config.candidate_roi: world XY distance from current body position < 5m; no point Z clipping
